images.alt: Band on stage illuminated by green lights with mixing console visible
images.description: Live band performing on stage bathed in green and blue lighting with hazy atmospheric glow. Black metal railing in foreground, large audio mixing console visible lower right with knobs, sliders, indicator lights. Drummer seated behind red drum kit on left. Guitarist in bright yellow shirt and green pants playing pale green guitar, lit by green spotlights. Two band members visible from right. Metal truss ceiling with starry-night effect. Energetic moody concert atmosphere.

images.alt: Rock band performing on night stage with purple haze lighting
images.description: Live band performing on covered stage viewed from low angle near front edge. Central guitarist playing light-colored electric guitar with reddish pickguard, gray jacket, leaning into performance. Drum kit behind and left with cymbals. Bass guitarist in long dark coat playing red bass guitar to right. Keyboardist in dark beanie behind red Nord keyboard. Dramatic green, blue, purple, pink lighting cutting through hazy atmosphere. Metal truss ceiling with vertical lights. Amplifiers, speakers, mic stands.

images.alt: Alzheimers Memory Walk stage with Santander finish arch and flags
images.description: Outdoor event setup on grassy field under cloudy sky. Raised metal truss stage with black floor, central steps, black canopy. Dark blue banner with light blue flower-like logo. Vertical 'Alzheimer's Society Memory Walk' banners. Large black speaker stacks, audio equipment. Blue inflatable 'FINISH' arch to left/right. Red Santander feather flags. Metal crowd barriers, green-clothed table with blue items. Trees on horizon.

images.alt: Memory Walk remembrance tree with handwritten tribute messages
images.description: Large green tree-shaped memorial display at Alzheimer's Society Memory Walk event. Painted plywood tree with branching cut-outs. Dozens of dark blue 'Alzheimer's Society MemoryWalk' ribbons hanging from branches with small white cards bearing handwritten messages of remembrance and love. Messages include 'Walking for my Nana Jasmin', 'Mum, words are not enough', 'I miss you Grandad'. Green grass, real trees, pale sky.

images.alt: Table of Alzheimers Memory Walk medals and branded lanyards
images.description: Table outdoors at event registration/giveaway station. Dark navy-blue cloth with large tangled pile of bright pink fabric collars/wristbands with silver bells, printed 'Alzheimer's Society Memory Walk'. Heap of royal blue lanyards with same branding. Smaller pile of light green lanyards. Stack of folded white fabric items in upper left. Part of tent base visible on right, grass underneath.

images.alt: Upside-down selfie of event staff in Alzheimers Society vests
images.description: Upside-down group selfie of four men at outdoor Alzheimer's Society Memory Walk event. All wearing blue event staff vests with reflective stripes, Alzheimer's Society branding with forget-me-not flower logo, 'EVENT STAFF' text. Stage setup with metal trussing, speakers, blue 'Alzheimer's Society Memory Walk' banners. Grassy park, trees, metal barriers, cloudy sky.

images.alt: Memory Walk crowd making heart shapes with hands behind barrier
images.description: Large outdoor group photo at Alzheimer's Society Memory Walk in park. Smiling woman in bright blue Alzheimer's Society Memory Walk T-shirt behind metal crowd barrier, hands above head in heart shape. Very large crowd stretching far back, most in blue shirts making heart shapes. Yellow and red flags on left, portable toilets in background, white ambulance on right. Dense trees surrounding park, overcast sky.

images.alt: Acoustic duo performing on mini stage in dry field with guy ropes
images.description: Outdoor live music setup on dry grassy field under overcast sky. Temporary metal truss stage with black canopy roof, silver lattice framework, bright orange ratchet straps anchored to ground. Red-and-white barrier tape. Two men in dark clothing playing acoustic guitars on stage. Speakers, mic stands, cables, blue crate, metal steps. Blue wheelie bin, white car, low industrial building, red car, large leafy tree.

images.alt: Staging Events logo with blue globe and play button on dark background
images.description: Modern digital logo on black rectangular background. Stylized blue emblem resembling swirling globe/orbit with curved ribbon-like shapes in varying blue shades, glossy 3D appearance. Dark blue play-button triangle at center. Text 'STAGINGEVENTS' in bold uppercase sans-serif - 'STAGING' in blue gradient, 'EVENTS' in gray-to-silver gradient. Sleek professional tech-oriented look.

images.alt: Technical diagram of medium trussing gantry frame
images.description: Technical rendering of large metal truss structure against solid dark background. Rectangular portal/gantry frame made from off-white/light beige trussing. Two tall vertical towers connected by top horizontal beam. Lattice pattern with triangular bracing. Base outrigger/stabilizing feet. Thin white dimension lines for width and height. CAD/3D model of stage truss or lighting rig.

images.alt: Technical diagram of large trussing gantry frame
images.description: CAD-style 3D rendering of large metal truss structure for stage/event/lighting use. Dark navy/black background, pale cream/off-white wireframe. Two tall vertical truss columns with lattice diagonal cross-bracing. Top horizontal beam spanning between columns, second lower crossbeam. Base support sections extending outward as stabilizing feet/outriggers. Faint dimension lines along bottom and right side showing overall width and height.

images.alt: 7x6m mobile stage with line-array PA flown at both sides
images.description: Front view of a covered 7x6m mobile show stage in the Kelham Island Museum courtyard. Line-array speakers hang from both front corners, with monitor speakers across the deck and PA cabinets at ground level. A Migration Matters Festival banner hangs at the rear.

images.alt: Dance group performing on a covered 7x6m festival stage
images.description: Four adult dancers in gold, pink and orange costumes perform on the covered show stage. Stage monitors line the front of the deck and a flown line-array speaker is visible beside the Migration Matters Festival backdrop.

images.alt: Speaker using a microphone on a 7x6m festival stage
images.description: Wide view of the covered show stage during a spoken performance. Line-array speakers are flown from both front corners, monitor speakers sit across the deck and PA cabinets stand at ground level.

images.alt: Dancers performing on a 7x6m show stage with flown PA
images.description: Wide view of adult dancers performing on a covered 7x6m show stage at Kelham Island Museum. Flown speaker arrays frame the stage and the Migration Matters Festival backdrop is visible behind the performers.
